obligations.domain: X : Type with supplied m : PrecisionMetric X. Sequences u : ℕ → X and precisions k : ℕ.
obligations.normOrMetric: m.close k x y is the declared ball relation. The PrecisionMetric structure supplies reflexivity, symmetry, the two-input triangle law at k+1→k, and finer-ball inclusion k+1→k.
obligations.quantifiers: For every u, if ∀k ∃N ∀n,p≥N, close k (u n) (u p), then ∃x∈X ∀k ∃N ∀n≥N, close k (u n) x.
obligations.statement: Complete m := ∀ u : ℕ → X, Cauchy m u → ∃ x : X, Converges m u x.
obligations.boundary: The conditional demonstration assumes Complete m through its printed user axiom assumedComplete.

obligations.domain: X,Y : Type; mx : PrecisionMetric X and my : PrecisionMetric Y; u : ℕ → X → Y and f : X → Y.
obligations.normOrMetric: my.close for approximation in Y and mx.close for the input continuity modulus. The proof uses my.symmetric, my.triangle and my.finer.
obligations.quantifiers: Uniform convergence is ∀k ∃N ∀n≥N ∀x∈X, my.close k (u n x) (f x). Every approximant is uniformly continuous: ∀n ∀k ∃l ∀x,y∈X, mx.close l x y → my.close k (u n x) (u n y).
obligations.statement: Under those two premises, ∀k ∃l ∀x,y∈X, mx.close l x y → my.close k (f x) (f y). The same N applies to all x in the convergence premise.
obligations.boundary: The assertion transfers uniform continuity in the specified precision spaces.

obligations.domain: E is a Banach space over ℝ. Every f_n : ℝ → E is C¹, v ∈ E, and g : ℝ → E. For the infinite-series version set S_n(x)=∑_{j=0}^{n-1} a_j(x) with every a_j C¹ and set f_n=S_n.
obligations.normOrMetric: The norm of E, real Fréchet derivative in a one-dimensional domain, and supremum norm on each K_R=[−R,R] for R>0.
obligations.statement: Conclude ∃f:ℝ→E C¹ with f(0)=v and ∀x∈ℝ, f'(x)=g(x), such that ∀R>0 ∀ε>0 ∃N ∀n≥N ∀x∈K_R, ‖f_n(x)−f(x)‖<ε. For f_n=S_n the differentiated partial sum is ∑_{j<n} a'_j.
obligations.boundary: Application requires a specific Banach-space and source-series binding with independent convergence bounds.

obligations.domain: A Banach space E over ℝ or ℂ. T(t) is a bounded linear map E→E for each t∈[0,∞). Fixed M≥1 and ω∈ℝ.
obligations.normOrMetric: The norm on E and operator norm on bounded linear maps.
obligations.statement: A source application supplies the semigroup identities, strong continuity, and the bound for its specified E and M,ω.
obligations.boundary: The norm bound is an explicit premise for the stability specification below.

obligations.domain: H is a complex Hilbert space and A:D(A)⊂H→H is densely defined and self-adjoint. B,C and B_j are Borel subsets of ℝ.
obligations.normOrMetric: Hilbert norm for vector convergence, strong operator topology for P, and positive scalar measure μ_x(B)=⟨P(B)x,x⟩.
obligations.quantifiers: For each B, P(B) is an orthogonal projection; P(∅)=0 and P(ℝ)=Id; for every B,C, P(B∩C)=P(B)P(C); for every pairwise-disjoint sequence (B_j) and every x∈H, lim_N ‖P(∪_j B_j)x−∑_{j<N} P(B_j)x‖_H=0.
obligations.statement: A spectral adapter supplies such P, D(A)={x∈H:∫ℝ λ² dμ_x(λ)<∞}, and ∀x∈D(A), lim_R→∞ ‖Ax−∫_{[-R,R]} λ dP(λ)x‖_H=0. The truncated integrals are the bounded spectral integrals of λ·1_[−R,R](λ).
obligations.boundary: The inherited GapAt predicate assumes a set of real energies and does not construct this PVM.

obligations.domain: The same E and T as in the strongly continuous semigroup specification. Fixed T_max≥0, M≥1 and ω∈ℝ.
obligations.normOrMetric: E norm and the same T(t) operator norm; M,ω,T_max are part of the application input.
obligations.quantifiers: For every t∈[0,T_max] and every x,y∈E.
obligations.boundary: The inequality is the requested consequence of an independently supplied operator bound.
